app.name: BorrowBox
app.tagline: Borrow what you need from your neighbours

login.title: Sign in
login.subtitle: Welcome back! Sign in to continue.
login.passwordReset: Your password has been changed and you were signed out everywhere. Sign in with your new password.

register.title: Create your account
register.subtitle: Join your neighbours and start borrowing in a minute.
register.passwordHint: 8–64 characters, with at least one letter and one digit

export.title: Download your data
export.description: Get a copy of the personal data BorrowBox holds about you, as a JSON file.

delete.title: Delete your account
delete.description: Your personal data will be erased. Records we must keep by law (e.g. payments) are anonymised. This cannot be undone.

payouts.title: Payouts
payouts.description: To accept paid bookings, set up the Stripe account BorrowBox pays you through.

appearance.title: Appearance
appearance.followDevice: Follow my device's light or dark setting
appearance.hint: Turned off, the sun and moon button in the top bar chooses light or dark.

deleteDialog.title: Delete your account?
deleteDialog.body: This permanently deletes your account and signs you out everywhere.
deleteDialog.noPassword: For your security, you need to have signed in within the last 5 minutes.

validation.password: 8–64 characters, with at least one letter and one digit
validation.euros: Enter an amount, e.g. 5.50 (no thousands separators)

explore.emptyHint: Try a larger distance or fewer filters.

lend.title: Lend your things
lend.text: Earn a little from things you rarely use. Listing one takes a few minutes.

find.title: Find it nearby
find.text: Search what your neighbours lend and see roughly where it is.

pay.title: Pay safely
pay.text: Pay through BorrowBox. The deposit comes back after the return.

handoff.title: Hand over with a QR code
handoff.text: Scan a code at pickup and at return, so you both confirm.

item.areaHint: The exact spot is never shown. Once a booking goes ahead, you agree with the lender where to meet.
item.depositHint: Charged with the rent and refunded when the item comes back.

listing.title: Title
listing.descriptionHint: Condition, what's included, how pickup works.
listing.ratesIntro: Fill in the rates you want to offer (at least one).
listing.noRate: Add at least one rate, or lend it for free.
listing.locationIntro: Put the pin where the item is picked up: tap the map or drag the pin.
listing.dropPin: Tap the map to place the pin.
listing.locationPrivacy: Others only see an area of about 300 m around it, never the exact spot.
listing.photosIntro: Up to {{max}} photos, 10 MB each. The first one is the cover.
listing.photosSkipped: {{count}} photos weren't added: up to {{max}} per item.
listing.dragToReorder: Drag the photos to change their order.

photoErrors.unsupported: This file type isn't supported here. Try JPEG or PNG.
photoErrors.tooSmall: Photo too small (at least 320 px wide).

listing.publishIntro: Once published, the item shows up in search.
listing.isActive: This item is published. Changes apply right away.
listing.isPaused: This item is paused and doesn't show up in search.
listing.leaveUnsaved: You have unsaved changes. Leave this page?
listing.photoNeeded: Add at least one photo to continue: items are listed with a photo.

myItems.emptyHint: Lend the things you rarely use to your neighbours.
myItems.deleteMessage: “{{title}}” and its photos will be deleted for good.

notice.title: Confirm your email address
notice.text: Open the link we sent to {{email}}. You need a confirmed email to publish items, book and chat.
notice.sent: Sent. Check your inbox (and the spam folder). We send at most one email a minute.

verify.doneText: Thank you! You can now publish items, book and chat with your neighbours.
verify.expiredText: Confirmation links work for 24 hours. Ask for a new one.
verify.invalidTitle: This link doesn’t work any more
verify.invalidText: It may have been used already, or a newer link replaced it.
verify.resent: We’ve sent a new link to {{email}}. Check your inbox (and the spam folder).
verify.signInToResend: Sign in and ask for a new link in Settings.

forgot.title: Forgot your password?
forgot.subtitle: Enter your account’s email and we’ll send you a link to set a new one.
forgot.sentText: If there’s an account for {{email}}, we’ve sent it a link to set a new password.
forgot.sentHint: The link works for 10 minutes. If it doesn’t arrive, check your spam folder, or send it again once the countdown ends.

reset.title: Set a new password
reset.subtitle: Once it’s set, you’ll be signed out on every device and sign in again with the new one.
reset.expiredText: Reset links work for 10 minutes. Ask for a new one.
reset.invalidTitle: This link doesn’t work any more
reset.invalidText: It may have been used already, or a newer link replaced it.

password.title: Password
password.changed: Password changed. Your other devices have been signed out.
password.noPassword: You sign in with Google, so there’s no password to change. We can email you a link to set one; setting it signs you out on every device, this one included.
password.linkSent: We’ve sent a link to {{email}}. It works for 10 minutes.

payouts.title: Payouts
payouts.intro: BorrowBox pays lenders through Stripe. Stripe asks for your bank account and checks your identity on its own pages; BorrowBox never sees those details.
payouts.opening: Opening Stripe… This can take up to a minute.

NOT_STARTED.title: Not set up yet
NOT_STARTED.text: Set up payouts to accept bookings that cost something. Free bookings don’t need them.

INCOMPLETE.title: Details missing
INCOMPLETE.text: Stripe still needs some details from you. Continue where you left off.

PENDING.title: Being checked
PENDING.text: Stripe is checking your details. This usually takes a few minutes; come back to this page to see the result.

READY.title: Ready
READY.text: Payouts are set up: you can accept paid bookings.

RESTRICTED.title: Paused by Stripe
RESTRICTED.text: Stripe has paused payouts to your account, usually because it needs updated details. Until then you can’t accept paid bookings.

payouts.payoutsDisabled: Stripe hasn’t enabled payouts to your bank yet. Your Stripe dashboard shows what’s missing.
payouts.linkExpired: The Stripe page expired before you finished. Continue with a new one.
payouts.verifyFirst: Confirm your email address before setting up payouts.
payouts.dashboardHint: The dashboard opens in this tab. There you can see your payouts and change your bank account.

how.title: How you get paid
how.stripe: Stripe holds your payout details and pays your balance into your bank account.
how.transfer: The renter pays when you accept. BorrowBox transfers the rent to you after the rental, minus a small fee if you asked for a deposit.
how.deposit: The deposit goes back to the renter after the item is returned.

errors.EMAIL_NOT_VERIFIED: Confirm your email address first, with the link we sent you.
errors.PAYOUTS_NOT_SET_UP: Finish setting up payouts first: the dashboard opens once Stripe has your details.
errors.PROVIDER_UNAVAILABLE: Stripe isn’t answering right now. Please try again in a moment.

payment.title: Pay for your booking
payment.depositHint: Charged now, refunded after you return the item
payment.payBy: Pay by {{date}}, or the booking expires.
payment.unavailable: Card payments aren’t available right now. Please try again later.
payment.formFailed: The payment form didn’t load. Check your connection and try again.
payment.cardOnly: Cards only. Stripe handles your card: BorrowBox never sees its number.
payment.paid: Paid. Taking you to your booking…
payment.slow: Your payment is still being confirmed. We’ll email you as soon as it’s done.
payment.attemptFailed: The payment didn’t go through. Please try again.
payment.stripeFailed: Something went wrong with the payment. Your card wasn’t charged; please try again.

closed.default: There’s nothing to pay for this booking any more.
closed.cancelled: This booking closed before it was paid.
closed.refunded: This booking closed. If you paid, the money is on its way back to your card.

errors.PAYMENT_WINDOW_CLOSED: It’s too late to pay for this booking: paying must start at least 10 minutes before the pay-by time.
errors.INVALID_STATE: This booking isn’t waiting for payment: it’s already paid, being paid, or closed.
errors.PROVIDER_UNAVAILABLE: Stripe isn’t answering right now. Please try again in a moment.

price.payoutWhen: Sent to your payout account once the booking is completed.
price.lenderDeposit: The renter also pays a {{deposit}} deposit, which goes back to them when the item is returned. The deposit cost covers its card fees.
price.fromOffer: The rent comes from an offer in the chat.

book.title: When do you need it?
book.pick: Pick a start and an end to see the price.
book.nothingToPay: Nothing to pay: this one is free.
book.depositExplained: The {{deposit}} deposit is charged with the rent and refunded to your card when you return the item. Your bank may take a few days to show the refund.
book.payLater: Nothing is charged now. If the lender accepts, you pay within 24 hours (or before the start, if that is sooner).

problem.startTooSoon: A booking starts at least an hour from now.
problem.startTooFar: A booking starts at most 180 days ahead.
problem.endBeforeStart: The end must come after the start.
problem.tooShort: That is shorter than this item’s shortest booking.
problem.tooLong: That is longer than this item’s longest booking.
problem.taken: Someone has already booked part of that time.

errors.SLOT_TAKEN: Someone has just booked part of that time. Please pick another.
errors.DUPLICATE_REQUEST: You already have a request or booking for this item at that time.
errors.REQUEST_LIMIT_REACHED: You have 10 requests waiting for an answer. Wait for some answers or withdraw one first.
errors.OWN_ITEM: You can’t book your own item.
errors.ITEM_UNAVAILABLE: This item isn’t taking bookings right now.
errors.INVALID_PERIOD: That time doesn’t work for this item. Please pick another.
errors.PAYOUTS_NOT_SET_UP: Set up payouts first, so you can be paid for this booking.
errors.NOT_FOUND: This booking doesn’t exist, or it isn’t yours.
errors.EMAIL_NOT_VERIFIED: Confirm your email address first, with the link we sent you. You can send a new link from Settings.

list.title: Bookings
list.emptyRenter: Find something nearby and ask to borrow it.
list.emptyLender: When someone asks to borrow one of your items, it shows here.

detail.timeLeft: Time left to pay: {{h}} h {{m}} min {{s}} s
detail.meet: Arrange where and when to meet in the chat.
detail.changed: This booking changed meanwhile. Here is how it stands now.

REQUESTED.RENTER: Waiting for {{name}} to answer. If they don’t by {{time}}, the request expires.
REQUESTED.LENDER: {{name}} would like to borrow this. Answer by {{time}}, or the request expires.

ACCEPTED.RENTER: {{name}} accepted. Pay by {{time}} to keep the booking.
ACCEPTED.LENDER: You accepted. {{name}} has until {{time}} to pay, or the booking expires.

CONFIRMED.RENTER: Confirmed. There is nothing to pay.
CONFIRMED.LENDER: Confirmed. There is nothing to pay.

PAID.LENDER: {{name}} has paid. The booking is confirmed.

RETURNED.RENTER: You returned the item. The booking completes in 48 hours.
RETURNED.LENDER: {{name}} returned the item. The booking completes in 48 hours.

COMPLETED.RENTER: Completed. Any deposit goes back to your card.
COMPLETED.LENDER: Completed. The rent goes to your payout account.

DISPUTED.RENTER: The lender reported a problem. BorrowBox will look into it and contact you both.
DISPUTED.LENDER: You reported a problem. BorrowBox will look into it and contact you both.

DECLINED_OVERLAP.RENTER: Declined: {{name}} accepted another booking for the same time.
DECLINED_OVERLAP.LENDER: Declined because you accepted another booking for the same time.

CANCELLED_ITEM_DELETED.RENTER: Cancelled because the item was removed.
CANCELLED_ITEM_DELETED.LENDER: Cancelled because you removed the item.

CANCELLED_ACCOUNT_DELETED.RENTER: Cancelled because an account was deleted.
CANCELLED_ACCOUNT_DELETED.LENDER: Cancelled because an account was deleted.

EXPIRED_NO_ANSWER.LENDER: Expired: you didn’t answer in time.

EXPIRED_STARTED.RENTER: Expired: the start time came before it went ahead.
EXPIRED_STARTED.LENDER: Expired: the start time came before it went ahead.

EXPIRED_PAYMENT_TIMEOUT.RENTER: Expired: it wasn’t paid in time.

policy.renterEarly: Cancel more than 24 hours before the start and you get everything back except the service fee.
policy.renterLate: Within 24 hours of the start, you get the deposit and half the rent back; the lender receives the other half.
policy.nowEarly: Your booking starts in more than 24 hours, so the first rule applies.
policy.nowLate: Your booking starts within 24 hours, so the second rule applies.
policy.lenderPaid: If you cancel, {{name}} gets everything back and you receive nothing for this booking.
policy.nothingPaid: Nothing has been paid yet, so cancelling costs nothing.
policy.renterEarlyShort: You get everything back except the service fee.
policy.renterLateShort: You get the deposit and half the rent back; the lender receives the other half.

accept.title: Accept this request?
accept.message: {{name}} asked for {{period}}. Other requests for the same time are declined.

decline.title: Decline this request?
decline.message: {{name}} will be told the item isn’t available then.

withdraw.title: Withdraw your request?
withdraw.message: {{name}} won’t be able to accept it any more.

chat.emptyHint: Ask a lender about an item and your conversation shows up here.
chat.closedBanner: This conversation is read-only: the item was deleted or an account was closed.
chat.startHint: Say hello and ask what you’d like to know about the item.
chat.maskedHint: Contact details are hidden until you have a booking that goes ahead.

system.BOOKING_ACCEPTED: The lender accepted the booking. It’s waiting for payment.
system.BOOKING_CONFIRMED: The booking is confirmed. Arrange here where and when to meet.
system.BOOKING_PAID: The booking is paid. Arrange here where and when to meet.
system.OFFER_WITHDRAWN: The lender withdrew the price offer.

report.title: Report this message
report.intro: Why are you reporting it? We’ll review it; the other person isn’t told.

problems.tooFar: The start can be at most 180 days ahead.
problems.tooLong: A booking can last at most 90 days.

offers.makeIntro: Offer a lower rent for a period. The deposit stays the same. The renter can book it at once.
offers.rentTooHigh: At most {{max}}, the list price for this period.

offers.replaces: Sending it replaces your open offer.
offers.bookMessage: {{start}} – {{end}}, {{total}} in total. The lender has already agreed: you’ll be asked to pay next.
